schema: Each side is a clause (doc, ref, quote), a table row (doc, ref, quote joined with ' | '), or a figure value (doc, ref, figure_id, key, value). Quotes are checked against the Markdown by validate.py.

a.quote: Travel expense claims must be submitted within 60 days of the end of the trip.

b.quote: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date.

conflicts.note: Claim deadline is 60 days in one policy and 30 days in the other.

a.quote: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid vacation per year.

b.quote: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid vacation per year.

conflicts.note: Annual vacation is 20 days vs 25 days.

a.quote: up to 5 paid days of bereavement leave

b.quote: up to 3 paid days of bereavement leave

conflicts.note: Bereavement leave for immediate family is 5 days vs 3 days.

a.quote: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

b.quote: Passwords must be at least 10 characters long.

conflicts.note: Minimum password length is 14 vs 10.

a.quote: Security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Centre within 1 hour of discovery.

b.quote: All other incidents, including cyber incidents, must be reported within 24 hours of discovery.

conflicts.note: Cyber incident reporting window is 1 hour vs 24 hours.

a.quote: Receipts and expense records are kept for 6 years.

b.quote: Financial records are retained for 7 years.

conflicts.note: Expense records are financial records. Retention is 6 years vs 7 years.

a.quote: Every business trip requires written approval from the employee's line manager before any booking is made, regardless of cost.

b.quote: Purchases and travel costs under CAD 500 do not require prior approval.

conflicts.note: Travel under CAD 500 needs approval in one policy and none in the other.

a.quote: Business class is not permitted on any flight, for any employee, under any circumstances.

b.quote: Business class may be booked for flights longer than 6 hours with director approval.

conflicts.note: Business class is banned in one policy and allowed with approval in the other.

a.quote: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week without approval.

b.quote: All remote work requires prior written approval from the employee's department head.

conflicts.note: Remote work needs no approval vs always needs approval.

a.quote: Employees must not use personal devices to access company email.

b.quote: Employees may access company email from a personal phone, provided the company device management app is installed.

conflicts.note: Personal devices for email are forbidden vs allowed with a condition.

a.quote: This policy governs all vehicle rentals used for business travel, and employees book rental cars through the travel portal.

b.quote: This policy governs all vehicle rentals, and all rental agreements must be arranged by the Procurement team.

conflicts.note: Both policies claim vehicle rentals with different booking routes.

a.quote: The Compliance team is responsible for approving the deletion of customer data.

b.quote: IT Security approves all deletion of customer data before it is carried out.

conflicts.note: Two different teams own the approval of customer data deletion.

a.quote: A business day is any day from Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.

b.quote: A business day is any day from Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays.

conflicts.note: Business day includes Saturday in one policy only.

a.quote: A delay is a departure more than 3 hours after the scheduled time.

b.quote: A delay is a departure 2 hours or more after the scheduled time.

conflicts.note: A delay starts after 3 hours in one policy and at 2 hours in the other.

a.quote: Confidential data means customer personal data and financial records.

b.quote: Confidential data means customer personal data, financial records and employee records.

conflicts.note: Employee records count as confidential in one definition only.

a.quote: Claims are submitted using Form EX-12 in the finance portal.

b.quote: Form EX-12 was withdrawn on 1 September 2024. All claims must be filed on Form EX-14 in the finance portal.

conflicts.note: Travel Policy cites a form that the Expense Policy says is withdrawn.

a.quote: Safety incidents are handled under Safety Policy SAF-002.

b.quote: This policy replaces Safety Policy SAF-002, which was withdrawn on 15 January 2025.

conflicts.note: Incident Reporting Policy cites SAF-002, which the Crew policy says is withdrawn.

a.quote: For personal device rules, see the Bring Your Own Device Policy IT-007.

b.quote: Bring Your Own Device Policy IT-007 was retired on 1 February 2025.

conflicts.note: Acceptable Use Policy points to IT-007, which the Information Security Policy says is retired.

a.quote: Toronto | CAD 95

b.quote: Toronto | CAD 85

conflicts.note: Toronto per diem is CAD 95 vs CAD 85.

a.quote: Economy | 1 | 23 kg

b.quote: Economy | 1 | 20 kg

conflicts.note: Economy checked bag limit is 23 kg vs 20 kg.

a.quote: Credit card | 7 business days

b.quote: Credit card | 10 business days

conflicts.note: Credit card refund time is 7 vs 10 business days.

a.quote: Short-haul | 12 hours

b.quote: Short-haul | 10 hours

conflicts.note: Short-haul minimum rest is 12 hours vs 10 hours.

a.quote: Up to CAD 2,500 | Department manager

b.quote: Up to CAD 5,000 | Department manager

conflicts.note: Department manager approval limit is CAD 2,500 vs CAD 5,000.

b.quote: The maximum flight duty period for long-haul pilots is 12 hours.

conflicts.note: The chart shows 13 hours for long-haul pilots. The text says 12.

b.quote: A cabin bag must not exceed 55 x 40 x 20 cm.

conflicts.note: The diagram shows a 23 cm depth. The text says 20 cm.

a.quote: Bookings must be made through the approved travel portal.

b.quote: Employees must book flights through the approved travel portal.

a.quote: Receipts are required for any expense over CAD 25.

b.quote: Receipts are required for any expense over CAD 25.

a.quote: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year.

b.quote: Employees are entitled to 10 paid sick days each year.

a.quote: The company tops up parental leave benefits for up to 16 weeks.

b.quote: Parental leave is topped up by the company for 16 weeks.

a.quote: Multi-factor authentication is required for remote access to company systems.

b.quote: Multi-factor authentication is required for remote access to company systems.

a.quote: Accounts are locked after 5 failed sign-in attempts.

b.quote: Accounts are locked after 5 failed sign-in attempts.

a.quote: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT service desk immediately.

b.quote: Employees must report a lost or stolen device to the IT service desk immediately.

a.quote: Safety incidents must be reported within 24 hours.

b.quote: Crew must report safety incidents within 24 hours.

near_misses.note: Same 24 hour window for safety incidents.

a.quote: Passengers may cancel within 24 hours of booking for a full refund.

b.quote: Passengers who cancel within 24 hours of booking are entitled to a full refund.

a.quote: The excess baggage fee is CAD 100 per bag above the allowance.

b.quote: The excess baggage fee is CAD 100 per bag above the allowance.

a.quote: Business | 2 | 32 kg

b.quote: Business | 2 | 32 kg

near_misses.note: Matching row in tables that differ on another row.

a.quote: Crew must not report for duty within 8 hours of consuming alcohol.

b.quote: Crew may not operate a flight within 8 hours of consuming alcohol.

a.quote: A legal hold overrides all retention schedules.

b.quote: A legal hold overrides all retention schedules.

a.quote: Personnel files are retained for 7 years after employment ends.

b.quote: Personnel files are retained for 7 years after employment ends.

a.quote: Contracts over CAD 50,000 require three competitive quotes.

b.quote: Any single purchase over CAD 50,000 must follow the competitive quote process in the Procurement Policy.

near_misses.note: Expense Policy defers to the Procurement Policy.

a.quote: Economy class is the default for all flights.

b.quote: Economy class is the standard fare for flights.

a.quote: Hotel rates are capped at CAD 220 per night in major cities.

b.quote: Hotel stays are reimbursed up to CAD 220 per night.

a.quote: Use of a personal vehicle for business travel is reimbursed at CAD 0.68 per kilometre.

b.quote: Use of a personal vehicle is reimbursed at CAD 0.68 per kilometre.

a.quote: Gifts to customers valued over CAD 100 must be recorded in the gift register.

b.quote: Gifts to customers valued over CAD 100 must be recorded in the gift register.

a.quote: Remote work from outside Canada requires approval from both Human Resources and Legal.

b.quote: Working from outside Canada requires approval from HR and Legal.

a.quote: Employees receive a home office equipment allowance of CAD 500 once every 3 years.

b.quote: Employees receive a home office equipment allowance of CAD 500 once every three years.

near_misses.note: Same allowance, number written as a word.

a.quote: Employees may not install unapproved software on company devices.

b.quote: Software may only be installed after approval from IT.

a.quote: Unused vacation may be carried over into the next year, up to 5 days.

b.quote: Employees may carry over up to 5 unused vacation days to the following year.

a.quote: Complaints are acknowledged within 2 business days.

b.quote: Refund complaints are acknowledged within 2 business days.

a.quote: Duty and rest records are retained for 3 years.

b.quote: Crew duty records are retained for 3 years.
